title: HOTFIXES + M.T. Hymns, MIDI Playback & Admin Tools ⛪🎶
changes: HOTFIX — Fix App Icon not displaying properly
HOTFIX 2 — Fix landscape layout with collapsible right-side controls panel and smooth slide animations
NEW Mangalore Tunes (M.T.) Hymns section — browse the full M.T. Hymns book with lyrics, categories, favorites, and search
NEW MIDI Playback Engine — listen to hymn tunes with realistic Pipe Organ sound right inside the app. Configurable instrument in Settings
NEW Section Selector Screen — choose between CSI Hymns & Keerthanes or M.T. Hymns with beautiful cards and Kannada subtitles (ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಂಗೀತಗಳು, ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಂಕೀರ್ತನೆಗಳು, ಆರಾಧನಾ ಕ್ರಮ)
NEW Hide/Show Controls toggle on Hymn Detail — collapse playback and action controls for distraction-free reading, persists across orientation changes and songs
Section selector icons now use the actual hymn and keerthane drawable assets instead of generic vector icons
General stability improvements, animation polish, and bug fixes across the app
Thank you for using CSI Hymns! Report any issues from the app or Settings

title: CSI Hymns — Native Android Rewrite
changes: Welcome to CSI Hymns built natively in Kotlin with Jetpack Compose — faster, smoother, and designed for modern Android
Same app; your favorites and account data continue to sync where signed in
NEW Themes throughout using Android's New Material 3 expressive theming engine
NEW church-first Community Christmas Carols — browse by church, view lyrics or in-app PDFs, contribute songs and PDFs when signed in — On Christmas Season
Improved in-app PDF viewer with smoother scrolling and a single loader
Refined Material 3 expressive UI — bottom tab bar, button groups, Christmas snow ambience, and readable text on light accent colors
Fixed favorites not updating across Hymns and detail screens
Smoother tab switching and lighter motion across the main app
General stability fixes and polish across hymns, keerthane, settings, and carols
Thank you for using CSI Hymns — report issues from the app if anything looks off after the update

title: New Public Stable Version Released!
changes: Major improvements to Page Flip readability and smoothness (reduced text bleed-through, safer transitions, and more stable gesture behavior)
iOS back navigation is now smoother across key flows, including improved swipe-back behavior for Order of Service reader screens
Order of Service reader bottom navigation now stays properly anchored at the bottom, with cleaner page content spacing
Modernized in-app feedback messages across the app with cleaner floating status toasts for refresh/sync/update actions
Refined Order of Service title grouping and reader headers for clearer section context while navigating pages
Added ticket correction acknowledgement dialog on app open for Jira requests that moved to Done/Resolved/Closed
Android 15 edge-to-edge compatibility improvements in host activity and display cutout handling
Fixed audio plugin crash path by removing unused background audio service integration
Fixed crash when opening Settings from Page Flip hint snackbar action in hymn/keerthane/carol detail screens
General stability and runtime bug fixes across startup and ticket-status handling
For more info on changes, visit https://github.com/Reynold29/CSI-Hymns-and-Lyrics/commits/main/
